diffusion-types-four.alt: Four small grids of places. Relocation: a dashed arrow shows people carrying a trait from the hearth to a far place. Contagious: the trait fills the places nearest the hearth, like a ripple. Hierarchical: arrows run from a big city to smaller towns, skipping the places between. Stimulus: the idea reaches nearby places but changes form there, shown as circles turning into squares.
